PRIVACY_POLICY.TITLE: Privacy Policy
PRIVACY_POLICY.INTRODUCTION_CONTENT: We are committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
PRIVACY_POLICY.INFORMATION_COLLECTED_CONTENT: We may collect the following types of information:

PRIVACY_POLICY.INFO_ITEM_2: Booking information: check-in date, check-out date, room number
PRIVACY_POLICY.INFO_ITEM_3: Payment information: payment method, card number (encrypted)
PRIVACY_POLICY.INFO_ITEM_4: Usage information: booking history, system interactions

INTRODUCTION.TITLE: About the Software
INTRODUCTION.HEADING: Professional hotel management system
INTRODUCTION.DESCRIPTION: A comprehensive solution to optimize all hotel operations. From room operations, data management, multi-channel payment integration to OTA synchronization and e-invoicing, everything is centrally and smartly managed.
INTRODUCTION.FEATURE_ROOM_DESC: Visually control room status with floor plans and strictly manage shift handover history
INTRODUCTION.FEATURE_PAYMENT_DESC: Support multi-payment gateways (QR, Visa), track transfer history and detailed revenue reports
INTRODUCTION.FEATURE_BOOKING_DESC: Synchronize room rates via OTAs, connect Fanpage, Zalo, and Telegram messages centrally
INTRODUCTION.FEATURE_REPORT_DESC: Centrally manage guests, staff, services, debts, and hotel chains
INTRODUCTION.FEATURE_STAFF_DESC: Apply artificial intelligence to automate management processes, analyze data, and optimize operational efficiency
INTRODUCTION.FEATURE_CUSTOMIZE_DESC: Automate electrical device configuration, customer care Bots, and smart email management

FEATURES.TITLE: Key features
FEATURES.SUBTITLE: Built for real operations: fast, clear and revenue-focused.

ARTICLE.TITLE: Introduction
ARTICLE.DESCRIPTION: PHHotel is a hotel management software designed for quick rollout and ease of use. Just sign in and operate immediately: rooms, bookings, check-in/check-out, invoices & payments, upsell services, revenue reports and activity history.
ARTICLE.BULLET_1: Visual room management by floors with clear statuses (vacant/occupied/cleaning/maintenance/pre-booked).
ARTICLE.BULLET_2: Create reservations and check availability by date to avoid overlaps.
ARTICLE.BULLET_3: Flexible pricing by hour/day/overnight with surcharges and discounts.
ARTICLE.BULLET_4: Fast invoicing, deposit tracking and income/expense reconciliation.
ARTICLE.BULLET_5: Summary and detailed reports over time for faster decisions.
ARTICLE.IMAGE_CAPTION: An intuitive operations dashboard for quick front-desk actions

E_INVOICE_TEMPLATE.SUBTITLE: Choose templates compliant with cash-register e-invoices (Decree 123/2020, Decree 70/2025, Circular 78/2021)

GUIDE.TITLE: Hotels — cash register e-invoices (MTT)
GUIDE.DESC: Under Decree 70/2025 (Article 11), hotels selling directly to consumers must use e-invoices issued from cash registers. The 6-character serial must include letter M at position 4 (e.g. C25MAA). VAT-registered businesses should use pattern 1.
GUIDE.NO_MTT_DESC: No template with letter M found. Register an MTT template (pattern 1 + serial CxxMAA) on the General Department of Taxation portal or contact Sepay/EasyInvoice.

COMPLIANCE.GENERIC: Verify pattern and serial before use
COMPLIANCE.HOTEL_VAT_MTT_C: Recommended for hotels: VAT invoice with tax code, cash register (Decree 70/2025)
COMPLIANCE.HOTEL_VAT_MTT: VAT cash-register invoice — suitable for room/service sales
COMPLIANCE.HOTEL_SALES_MTT: Sales cash-register invoice — for direct tax method
COMPLIANCE.VAT_NOT_MTT: Standard VAT invoice (T serial), not MTT — hotels should use M serial
COMPLIANCE.NOT_MTT: Serial without M — not a cash register e-invoice
COMPLIANCE.NOT_FOR_HOTEL: This pattern is not suitable for hotel operations

RECONCILE.TITLE: Manual reconciliation
RECONCILE.SYSTEM_WIDE_TOOLTIP: Drop the hotel filter to see transactions of every user in the system
RECONCILE.HINT: When the SePay webhook fails or money has arrived but the system has not recorded it, check the bank statement first and then confirm manually. Every action records who did it and why.
RECONCILE.SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER: Transaction id, invoice number, transfer content…
RECONCILE.MODAL_WARNING_DESC: Use it only after checking the bank statement. The system stores who did it, when, and why.
RECONCILE.NOTE_PLACEHOLDER: E.g. SePay webhook failed; matched VCB statement on 01/09 at 13:14, amount 200,000 VND
